scope: Panhandle & South Plains (Lubbock, Potter, Randall counties; Lubbock, Amarillo)

records.name: South Plains Food Bank Food Assistance
records.description_en: The food bank gives food to people in need in Lubbock and the South Plains. You fill out a food help form and pick up a food voucher.
records.description_es: El banco de comida da alimentos a personas que los necesitan en Lubbock y el área de South Plains. Usted llena un formulario para pedir ayuda y recoge un vale de comida.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the South Plains who need food. The website does not list income limits.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en el área de South Plains que necesitan comida. La página web no muestra límites de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the Food Assistance Form online, or call. The food bank will text you when your application is processed.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene el formulario de ayuda con comida en línea o llame. El banco de comida le enviará un mensaje de texto cuando revise su solicitud.
records.hours: Applications Mon-Thu 8:30am-5:00pm. Voucher pickup: Mon, Tue, Thu 8:30am-11:45am and 12:30pm-5:30pm; Wed and Fri 8:30am-11:45am.
records.notes: Application status questions: text (806) 642-6724. The Need Food page has a zip-code search to find a nearby partner pickup site.

records.name: Senior Box Program (CSFP)
records.description_en: A free monthly box of USDA food for older adults with low income.
records.description_es: Una caja gratis de comida del USDA cada mes para personas mayores con pocos ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For seniors age 60 or older who meet income rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de 60 años o más que cumplen con las reglas de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the Senior Box referral form online or call the food bank.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene el formulario de la Caja para Adultos Mayores en línea o llame al banco de comida.
records.notes: Commodity Supplemental Food Program (USDA food managed by the Texas Department of Agriculture). Income limits not listed on the page. For application status call (806) 763-3003 and press 0.

records.name: Mobile Pantry
records.description_en: A food truck brings free food to towns across the South Plains on set days each month.
records.description_es: Un camión lleva comida gratis a pueblos del área de South Plains en ciertos días de cada mes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who need food in the counties the food bank serves. No income limits are listed.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que necesitan comida en los condados que atiende el banco de comida. No se muestran límites de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Check the monthly Mobile Pantry calendar online for a site and date near you, or call the food bank.
records.how_to_apply_es: Revise el calendario mensual de la Despensa Móvil en línea para ver un lugar y fecha cerca de usted, o llame al banco de comida.
records.notes: Calendar is updated monthly. Lubbock County sites listed when checked: Idalou (2nd Tue 10am), Wolfforth (4th Wed 11:30am), New Deal (4th Mon 10am), Shallowater (2nd Tue 11:30am). Confirm dates on the calendar.

records.name: Lubbock Meals on Wheels
records.description_en: Volunteers bring healthy meals to the homes of people who cannot easily leave home. They also offer a weekend meal program.
records.description_es: Voluntarios llevan comidas saludables a la casa de personas que no pueden salir fácilmente. También tienen un programa de comidas para el fin de semana.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the Lubbock area who are homebound, elderly, or disabled.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en el área de Lubbock que no pueden salir de casa, personas mayores o personas con discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply: Call Lubbock Meals on Wheels to ask about signing up.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Lubbock Meals on Wheels para preguntar cómo inscribirse.
records.notes: Serves people who are homebound, elderly, or disabled. Not government or United Way funded.

records.name: Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP) - Lubbock County
records.description_en: Helps pay electric, gas, and propane bills for low-income homes in Lubbock County. Also offers food vouchers and emergency help.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar las cuentas de luz, gas y propano de hogares con pocos ingresos en el condado de Lubbock. También da vales de comida y ayuda de emergencia.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Household income must be below 150% of the federal poverty guidelines.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Los ingresos del hogar deben estar por debajo del 150% de las guías federales de pobreza.
records.how_to_apply: Call Neighborhood House to ask about applying for energy help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Neighborhood House para preguntar cómo pedir ayuda con la energía.
records.notes: City of Lubbock Utilities lists Neighborhood House as the CEAP provider (150% FPL). Address, phone and hours confirmed on Upbring's Neighborhood House page. Also offers food vouchers, hygiene items, and prescription help.

records.name: Lubbock County General Assistance (LCGA)
records.description_en: Gives short-term money help to Lubbock County families, such as help with the current month's utility bill.
records.description_es: Da ayuda de dinero por poco tiempo a familias del condado de Lubbock, como ayuda con la cuenta de servicios del mes actual.
records.eligibility_summary_en: The household must include a disabled adult or a child under 18, have had no income for at least 30 days, and have lived in the county at least 30 days. Head of household must be 18 or older or married.
records.eligibility_summary_es: En el hogar debe haber un adulto con discapacidad o un niño menor de 18 años. El hogar no debe haber tenido ingresos por al menos 30 días y debe vivir en el condado por al menos 30 días. La persona a cargo del hogar debe tener 18 años o más, o estar casada.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Lubbock County resident for at least 30 days

records.how_to_apply: Call Lubbock County General Assistance.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Asistencia General del Condado de Lubbock.
records.notes: Pays the current month's utility bill only; deposits and past-due bills are not covered. Source: City of Lubbock Utility Assistance page.

records.name: Direct Client Assistance Program
records.description_en: Helps adults and seniors with utility bills, food, hygiene items, eye exams, glasses, and prescriptions.
records.description_es: Ayuda a adultos y personas mayores con cuentas de servicios, comida, artículos de higiene, exámenes de la vista, lentes y medicinas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For adults and seniors in need. The City of Lubbock says they have no income requirement for utility help.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para adultos y personas mayores que necesitan ayuda. La Ciudad de Lubbock dice que no piden un límite de ingresos para la ayuda con servicios.
documents_needed: Social Security cards for everyone in the household
Proof of income for the last 30 days (such as pay stubs)
Proof of any government benefits received
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the online Apply Now form or call. Spanish help is available on request.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene el formulario en línea (Registrar Ahora) o llame. Hay ayuda en español si la pide.
records.notes: They limit how many forms they accept each week. TXU, Reliant, and Atmos customers are asked to fill out a pre-intake form. Seniors 60+ may also get dental, prescription, hearing aid, and eyeglass help (Elderly Outreach Program). Email info@cclubbock.org.

records.name: The Salvation Army Lubbock
records.organization: The Salvation Army Texas South Plains
records.description_en: Offers shelter and other help in Lubbock, including a one-time utility payment of up to $150 per year.
records.description_es: Ofrece refugio y otras ayudas en Lubbock, incluyendo un pago único de hasta $150 al año para servicios públicos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in need in the Lubbock area.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que necesitan ayuda en el área de Lubbock.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit The Salvation Army in Lubbock.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite El Ejército de Salvación en Lubbock.
records.notes: $150-per-year one-time utility help is listed on the City of Lubbock Utility Assistance page (https://www.mylubbock.us/645/Utility-Assistance). Hours not listed online. National line 1-800-SAL-ARMY.

records.name: Public Housing and Housing Choice Vouchers (Section 8)
records.organization: Housing Authority of the City of Lubbock
records.description_en: Offers low-rent public housing and vouchers that help pay rent in private homes in Lubbock.
records.description_es: Ofrece vivienda pública de renta baja y vales que ayudan a pagar la renta en casas privadas en Lubbock.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households. Income limits follow HUD rules (up to 80% of area median income; most vouchers go to households at or below 30% of area median income).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares con pocos ingresos. Los límites de ingresos siguen las reglas de HUD (hasta el 80% del ingreso medio del área; la mayoría de los vales son para hogares con 30% o menos del ingreso medio del área).
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Housing Authority's application portal, where you can also check your waiting list status.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea por el portal de la Autoridad de Vivienda. Ahí también puede revisar su lugar en la lista de espera.
records.notes: Also offers Project Based Vouchers and Family Self-Sufficiency (806-776-2313). Contact info from lubbockha.org Contact page. Waiting list status not shown on the page.

records.name: City of Lubbock Community Development
records.description_en: Uses federal and state grants for housing repair, energy help and HVAC repairs, and services for people who are homeless or low-income.
records.description_es: Usa fondos federales y estatales para reparar viviendas, dar ayuda con la energía y reparar aire acondicionado y calefacción, y dar servicios a personas sin hogar o con pocos ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households, people who are homeless or at risk, and elderly or disabled people in Lubbock.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares con pocos ingresos, personas sin hogar o en riesgo de perderlo, y personas mayores o con discapacidad en Lubbock.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Community Development office to ask what programs are open.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina de Desarrollo Comunitario para preguntar qué programas están abiertos.
records.notes: Page does not list specific open programs or eligibility; call first.

records.name: ECHO West Texas - Homeless Coordinated Entry
records.description_en: Lubbock's lead agency for homeless services. It connects people who are homeless to housing and other help.
records.description_es: La agencia principal de Lubbock para servicios a personas sin hogar. Conecta a personas sin hogar con vivienda y otras ayudas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Lubbock who are homeless or about to lose housing.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en Lubbock que no tienen hogar o que están por perder su vivienda.
records.how_to_apply: Call ECHO West Texas to ask about coordinated entry.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a ECHO West Texas para preguntar sobre la entrada coordinada (coordinated entry).
records.notes: Lubbock's designated Continuum of Care lead agency. Email admin@echowtx.org. Hours not listed.

records.name: Open Door Community Center and Supportive Housing
records.description_en: A day center for people experiencing homelessness in Lubbock. Open Door also runs supportive housing and housing for survivors.
records.description_es: Un centro de día para personas sin hogar en Lubbock. Open Door también tiene vivienda con apoyo y vivienda para sobrevivientes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Lubbock who are homeless or were homeless.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en Lubbock que no tienen hogar o que estuvieron sin hogar.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in to the Community Center during open hours or call.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya al Centro Comunitario en horario abierto o llame.
records.notes: Admin office is at 1918 13th St.

records.name: StarCare Specialty Health System (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: Lubbock's public mental health center. Offers crisis help, counseling, medicine, substance use treatment, and services for people with intellectual disabilities.
records.description_es: El centro público de salud mental de Lubbock. Ofrece ayuda en crisis, consejería, medicinas, tratamiento para el uso de sustancias y servicios para personas con discapacidad intelectual.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the Lubbock area with mental health, substance use, or intellectual disability needs. Anyone in crisis can call 24/7.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en el área de Lubbock con necesidades de salud mental, uso de sustancias o discapacidad intelectual. Cualquier persona en crisis puede llamar.
records.how_to_apply: In a crisis call (806) 740-1414. For services, call intake at (806) 740-1421.
records.how_to_apply_es: En una crisis llame al (806) 740-1414. Para servicios, llame a admisión al (806) 740-1421.
records.notes: Crisis line (806) 740-1414 or toll-free (800) 687-7581. Intake toll-free (844) 472-8810. Medication refills (806) 740-1447. Addresses and hours not listed on the page checked; call intake.

records.name: VetStar Veteran Services
records.description_en: Helps veterans and their families with peer support and one-time help with rent, mortgage, utilities, food, and rides.
records.description_es: Ayuda a veteranos y sus familias con apoyo de compañeros y ayuda de una sola vez con renta, hipoteca, servicios públicos, comida y transporte.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For service members, veterans, and their families. The City of Lubbock says utility help is for veterans and surviving spouses with income at or below 80% of area median income, with proof of veteran status.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para miembros del servicio militar, veteranos y sus familias. La Ciudad de Lubbock dice que la ayuda con servicios es para veteranos y cónyuges sobrevivientes con ingresos del 80% o menos del ingreso medio del área, con prueba de ser veterano.
documents_needed: Proof of discharge / veteran status (VA card or DD-214)
records.how_to_apply: Call VetStar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a VetStar.
records.notes: Address and utility-help rules from https://www.mylubbock.us/645/Utility-Assistance. One-time financial help is through the Texas Veterans Commission General Assistance Program (GAP); peer support is through the Military Veterans Peer Network.

records.name: Community Health Center of Lubbock
records.organization: The Community Health Center of Lubbock, Inc.
records.description_en: A federally funded health center with medical, dental, eye, behavioral health, pharmacy, and pediatric care.
records.description_es: Un centro de salud con fondos federales que ofrece atención médica, dental, de la vista, salud mental, farmacia y pediatría.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone, including people without insurance.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para todos, incluso personas sin seguro médico.
records.how_to_apply: Call to make an appointment. Same-day care and telehealth are offered.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita. Hay citas el mismo día y consultas por video.
records.notes: Clinic sites: Main, 96 West, Arnett Benson, Chatman, Community Dental, Medical Office Plaza, Parkway, West. After hours, call the main number for the answering service. Sliding fee not stated on the page.

records.name: Lubbock Public Health Clinical Services
records.description_en: Low-cost vaccines for children and adults, and testing and treatment for sexually transmitted infections.
records.description_es: Vacunas de bajo costo para niños y adultos, y pruebas y tratamiento de infecciones de transmisión sexual.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the public. Help is available for people who cannot pay.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto al público. Hay ayuda para personas que no pueden pagar.
records.how_to_apply: Call or come during walk-in hours for STI testing.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame, o venga en el horario sin cita para pruebas de infecciones de transmisión sexual.
records.hours: STI walk-in: Tue all day, Wed morning, Thu afternoon, Fri morning. Call for other hours.
records.cost: Children on Medicaid/CHIP: free. Uninsured children: $13 first vaccine, $7 each additional. Uninsured adults: $20 per vaccine. Financial help available.
records.notes: Office hours not listed on the page; call first.

records.name: Workforce Solutions South Plains - Lubbock Career Center
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, job readiness workshops, and job training.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para encontrar trabajo, talleres para prepararse para el trabajo y capacitación laboral.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in the South Plains.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para personas que buscan trabajo en el área de South Plains.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Lubbock Career Center or call.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el Centro de Carreras de Lubbock o llame.
records.notes: Toll-free (800) 658-6284. Career Services (806) 765-5038. Closed weekends.

records.name: Child Care Services (CCS) - South Plains
records.description_en: Helps working families and students pay for child care.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias que trabajan y a estudiantes a pagar el cuidado de niños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Family income at or below 85% of state median income. Single parents must work, go to school, or train at least 25 hours a week (50 combined for two parents). Child must be under 13. Must live in one of 15 South Plains counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Los ingresos de la familia deben ser del 85% o menos del ingreso medio del estado. Los padres solteros deben trabajar, estudiar o capacitarse al menos 25 horas por semana (50 horas en total si son dos padres). El niño debe tener menos de 13 años. Debe vivir en uno de 15 condados de South Plains.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Resident of Bailey, Cochran, Crosby, Dickens, Floyd, Garza, Hale, Hockley, King, Lamb, Lubbock, Lynn, Motley, Terry, or Yoakum County

records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Texas Workforce Commission child care portal.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en el portal de cuidado infantil de la Comisión de la Fuerza Laboral de Texas (TWC).
records.notes: Enrollment was listed as CLOSED with a waitlist averaging about 15 months. Email childcareservices@spworkforce.org.

records.name: CitiAccess Paratransit
records.description_en: Door-to-door bus rides in Lubbock for people with disabilities who are approved for CitiAccess.
records.description_es: Viajes en autobús de puerta a puerta en Lubbock para personas con discapacidad que están aprobadas para CitiAccess.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For riders approved for CitiAccess (people with disabilities).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para pasajeros aprobados para CitiAccess (personas con discapacidad).
records.how_to_apply: Approved riders call Citibus customer service to book a ride.
records.how_to_apply_es: Los pasajeros aprobados llaman a servicio al cliente de Citibus para reservar un viaje.
records.notes: The OnDemand app has not been used for booking since June 26, 2023; call instead. Fare, hours and application details not on the page.

records.name: South Plains Area Agency on Aging
records.description_en: Helps older adults with benefits counseling, caregiver support, nursing home advocacy, and care coordination such as medical equipment, home repairs, and transportation.
records.description_es: Ayuda a personas mayores con consejería sobre beneficios, apoyo para cuidadores, defensa de residentes de asilos y coordinación de cuidados como equipo médico, reparaciones en casa y transporte.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people age 60 or older, their caregivers, and anyone eligible for Medicare.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de 60 años o más, sus cuidadores y cualquier persona con derecho a Medicare.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Information & Assistance line.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de Información y Asistencia.
records.notes: Information & Assistance toll-free (888) 418-6564. SPAG main line (806) 762-8721. County senior centers offer meals and rides.

records.name: High Plains Food Bank Food Assistance
records.description_en: The regional food bank for the Texas Panhandle. It refers people to more than 140 partner pantries and runs food programs.
records.description_es: El banco de comida regional del Panhandle de Texas. Le refiere a más de 140 despensas y agencias asociadas y tiene programas de comida.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the Texas Panhandle who need food.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en el Panhandle de Texas que necesitan comida.
records.how_to_apply: Call, use the contact form on the Get Help page, or download the Amarillo Referral List to find a nearby pantry.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame, use el formulario de contacto en la página Get Help, o descargue la lista de referencias de Amarillo para encontrar una despensa cerca.
records.notes: Serves 29 Panhandle counties through 140+ partner agencies. Also helps people apply for SNAP, CHIP, Medicaid, and TANF. Kids Cafe at 2199 SE 8th Ave.

records.name: Senior Adult Food Program (CSFP)
records.description_en: A free monthly box of food for older adults with low income.
records.description_es: Una caja gratis de comida cada mes para personas mayores con pocos ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For seniors age 60 or older who meet USDA income guidelines. You can self-declare your income.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de 60 años o más que cumplen con las guías de ingresos del USDA. Usted puede declarar sus ingresos sin mostrar pruebas.
records.how_to_apply: Sign up at a distribution site with ID, download the application online, or call.
records.how_to_apply_es: Inscríbase en un lugar de entrega con su identificación, descargue la solicitud en línea o llame.
records.notes: Proof of income is not required; you can self-declare income. Monthly 25-30 lb box plus cheese. Homebound seniors can name a proxy.

records.name: InterFaith Hunger Project
records.organization: Catholic Charities of the Texas Panhandle
records.description_en: A free monthly supply of groceries that you pick yourself.
records.description_es: Un surtido gratis de comida cada mes que usted mismo escoge.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people age 50 or older, or people on disability.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de 50 años o más, o personas que reciben beneficios por discapacidad.
documents_needed: Proof of address (utility bill or rental agreement)
records.how_to_apply: Come during open hours with your documents.
records.how_to_apply_es: Venga en el horario abierto con sus documentos.

records.name: Immigration Legal Services
records.organization: Catholic Charities of the Texas Panhandle
records.description_en: Low-cost help with citizenship, green cards, DACA, work permits, and other immigration papers.
records.description_es: Ayuda de bajo costo con ciudadanía, tarjeta de residencia (green card), DACA, permisos de trabajo y otros trámites de inmigración.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For immigrants in the Texas Panhandle who need help with immigration forms.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inmigrantes en el Panhandle de Texas que necesitan ayuda con formularios de inmigración.
records.how_to_apply: Call to schedule a consultation.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita de consulta.
records.notes: Also reachable at (806) 376-4571.

records.name: Utility Assistance Program (CEAP)
records.description_en: Helps pay utility bills to stop or prevent a shutoff, and teaches ways to save energy.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar las cuentas de servicios para evitar o detener un corte, y enseña formas de ahorrar energía.
records.eligibility_summary_en: You must have a current utility bill, live at the home, and have income at or below 150% of the poverty guidelines.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Debe tener una cuenta de servicios actual, vivir en la casa y tener ingresos del 150% o menos de las guías de pobreza.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the PCS portal. Elderly or disabled people can get a paper application at a PCS office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en el portal de PCS. Las personas mayores o con discapacidad pueden pedir una solicitud en papel en una oficina de PCS.
records.notes: Processing can take up to 90 days. Toll-free (800) 676-4727. City of Amarillo lists (806) 373-8389 for PCS utility help and says funding is occasional. Required documents listed on the PCS page in English and Spanish.

records.name: Housing Choice Voucher Program (Panhandle)
records.description_en: Helps low-income families pay rent in a private home they choose.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias con pocos ingresos a pagar la renta en una casa privada que ellas escogen.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households. People are picked from a waiting list based on income, application date, and other factors.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares con pocos ingresos. Las personas se escogen de una lista de espera según sus ingresos, la fecha de solicitud y otros factores.
documents_needed: Birth certificates for all household members
records.how_to_apply: Join the waiting list online at waitlistcheck.com or apply through the PCS portal.
records.how_to_apply_es: Anótese en la lista de espera en línea en waitlistcheck.com o solicite por el portal de PCS.
records.notes: Can also apply through https://pip.capsystems.com/PIP20/P16319S or with a paper application at a PCS office. Processing may take 30+ days. Toll-free (800) 676-4727.

records.name: Panhandle Transit
records.description_en: Public van rides you book ahead across the Texas Panhandle, including trips to appointments.
records.description_es: Viajes en camioneta pública que usted reserva con tiempo en el Panhandle de Texas, incluso para ir a citas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the public in the counties served.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto al público en los condados que atiende.
records.how_to_apply: Call at least 24 hours ahead to schedule a ride.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al menos 24 horas antes para reservar un viaje.
records.notes: Curb-to-curb demand-response service in 26 counties including Potter and Randall. No set schedule; rides are based on need and availability.

records.name: City of Amarillo Housing Choice Voucher (HCV) Program
records.description_en: Helps very low-income families pay rent for a home inside Amarillo city limits.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias con muy pocos ingresos a pagar la renta de una casa dentro de los límites de la ciudad de Amarillo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Income limits range from $28,600 for 1 person to $53,950 for 8 people.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Los límites de ingresos van de $28,600 para 1 persona a $53,950 para 8 personas.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Housing must be within Amarillo city limits

records.how_to_apply: Apply online only through the City of Amarillo HCV portal (email needed). Free help sessions Mon, Wed, Fri 10am-1pm at 808 S Buchanan St.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite solo en línea en el portal de vales de vivienda de la Ciudad de Amarillo (necesita un correo electrónico). Hay sesiones de ayuda gratis los lunes, miércoles y viernes de 10am a 1pm en 808 S Buchanan St.
records.notes: Waitlist status can be checked in the online participant portal. Serves very low-income families, seniors, and people with disabilities.

records.name: Community Development Rent and Homeless Assistance
records.description_en: The city offers rent help and help for people who are homeless. Ask for a Housing Navigator.
records.description_es: La ciudad ofrece ayuda con la renta y ayuda para personas sin hogar. Pida hablar con un Housing Navigator (guía de vivienda).
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Amarillo residents who are homeless or need help with rent.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de Amarillo que no tienen hogar o necesitan ayuda con la renta.
records.how_to_apply: Call and ask for a Housing Navigator, or visit the office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame y pida un Housing Navigator, o visite la oficina.
records.notes: Rental Assistance Program email: housing@amarillo.gov. Eligibility for rent help not listed; call first.

records.name: Coming Home Outreach and Supportive Housing
records.description_en: Outreach workers help people who are homeless find housing, with case management and mental health support.
records.description_es: Trabajadores de alcance ayudan a personas sin hogar a encontrar vivienda, con manejo de casos y apoyo de salud mental.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who are unsheltered, chronically homeless, living in a shelter, leaving jail or a hospital without housing, or at risk of homelessness, especially those facing mental illness, substance use, or justice involvement.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en la calle, que llevan mucho tiempo sin hogar, que viven en un refugio, que salen de la cárcel o del hospital sin vivienda, o que están en riesgo de perder su hogar, sobre todo si enfrentan problemas de salud mental, uso de sustancias o asuntos con la justicia.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the Request Help form online or call.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene el formulario de Pedir Ayuda en línea o llame.
records.notes: Request Help form linked from https://www.amarillo.gov/community-development/coming-home/.

records.name: Faith City Mission Shelter
records.description_en: Overnight shelter for men and for women, plus day shelter, meals, and clothing.
records.description_es: Refugio para pasar la noche para hombres y para mujeres, además de refugio de día, comidas y ropa.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For men, women, and children in Amarillo who are homeless or in crisis.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hombres, mujeres y niños en Amarillo que no tienen hogar o están en crisis.
records.how_to_apply: Go to the mission during open hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a la misión en horario abierto.
records.hours: Day shelter Mon-Sat 7:00am-5:00pm; night shelter daily 4:30pm-7:30am
records.notes: Hours from City of Amarillo I Need Help page (https://www.amarillo.gov/community-development/i-need-help/). Day shelter closed Sunday.

records.name: Guyon Saunders Resource Center
records.description_en: A low-barrier day shelter in Amarillo for people experiencing homelessness.
records.description_es: Un refugio de día en Amarillo con pocos requisitos para personas sin hogar.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who are homeless in Amarillo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas sin hogar en Amarillo.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during open hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya sin cita en horario abierto.
records.notes: Listed by the City of Amarillo as a low-barrier day shelter (closed Saturday). Address and phone could not be confirmed this session.

records.name: The Salvation Army Amarillo Night Shelter
records.description_en: Overnight shelter in Amarillo.
records.description_es: Refugio para pasar la noche en Amarillo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Amarillo who need a place to sleep.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en Amarillo que necesitan un lugar para dormir.
records.how_to_apply: Go to the shelter during evening intake hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya al refugio en el horario de entrada de la tarde.
records.notes: Shelter hours from the City of Amarillo I Need Help page. Local phone not listed; 1-800-SAL-ARMY is the national line.

records.name: Texas Panhandle Centers (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: The public mental health center for the Panhandle. Offers crisis help, counseling, medicine, substance use treatment, and disability services.
records.description_es: El centro público de salud mental del Panhandle. Ofrece ayuda en crisis, consejería, medicinas, tratamiento para el uso de sustancias y servicios para discapacidades.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the upper 21 Panhandle counties with mental health, substance use, or developmental disability needs. Anyone in crisis can call.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en los 21 condados del norte del Panhandle con necesidades de salud mental, uso de sustancias o discapacidad del desarrollo. Cualquier persona en crisis puede llamar.
records.how_to_apply: In a crisis call (806) 359-6699 or 988. For services call (806) 337-1000.
records.how_to_apply_es: En una crisis llame al (806) 359-6699 o al 988. Para servicios llame al (806) 337-1000.
records.notes: Crisis toll-free 1-800-692-4039. Non-crisis toll-free 1-800-299-3699. Early Childhood Intervention: (806) 358-8974. Hours not listed on the homepage.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Panhandle - Amarillo Center
records.description_en: Free job search help, job training, and workshops.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, capacitación laboral y talleres.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in the Texas Panhandle.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para personas que buscan trabajo en el Panhandle de Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Amarillo Center or call.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el Centro de Amarillo o llame.

records.name: Child Care Services (CCS) - Panhandle
records.description_en: Helps working families and students pay for child care.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias que trabajan y a estudiantes a pagar el cuidado de niños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Income at or below 85% of state median income. Single parents need about 25 hours a week of work, job search, school, or training (50 combined for two parents). Child must be under 13 (under 19 with a disability). Must live in one of 25 Panhandle counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Ingresos del 85% o menos del ingreso medio del estado. Los padres solteros necesitan unas 25 horas por semana de trabajo, búsqueda de trabajo, estudio o capacitación (50 horas en total si son dos padres). El niño debe tener menos de 13 años (menos de 19 si tiene una discapacidad). Debe vivir en uno de 25 condados del Panhandle.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Texas Workforce Commission child care portal.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en el portal de cuidado infantil de la Comisión de la Fuerza Laboral de Texas (TWC).
records.notes: Has a waitlist; non-priority families usually wait 6-9 months. Check status: ccapps@wspanhandle.com or (806) 372-2836. General line (806) 372-5521.

records.name: Amarillo City Transit Reduced Fare
records.description_en: Seniors, students, and people with disabilities pay half price on city buses.
records.description_es: Personas mayores, estudiantes y personas con discapacidad pagan la mitad del precio en los autobuses de la ciudad.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For seniors, students, and people with disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas mayores, estudiantes y personas con discapacidad.
documents_needed: Disability: Social Security award letter or Medicare card
records.how_to_apply: Bring your documents to the transit office during business hours to get a Reduced Fare ID card.
records.how_to_apply_es: Lleve sus documentos a la oficina de tránsito en horario de oficina para recibir su tarjeta de tarifa reducida.
records.notes: Second office: 801 SE 23rd Ave (Mon-Fri 8am-5pm). Also (806) 378-6846. Works for single rides, day passes, and monthly passes. ACT-Connect ID holders get the reduced fare without a separate card.

records.name: ACT-Connect Paratransit
records.description_en: Door-to-door rides for people with disabilities who cannot use regular city buses.
records.description_es: Viajes de puerta a puerta para personas con discapacidad que no pueden usar los autobuses normales de la ciudad.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For certified people who cannot use fixed-route buses because of a disability.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas certificadas que no pueden usar los autobuses de ruta fija por una discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply: Complete the application and physician form, then call to schedule an interview.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud y el formulario del médico, y luego llame para hacer una cita para una entrevista.
records.cost: $2 per trip in service area; $4 outside; free age 5 and under; 20-ride booklet $36
records.notes: Free round-trip ride to the interview is available on request.

records.name: Panhandle Area Agency on Aging
records.description_en: Helps older adults with meals, free rides, Medicare counseling, caregiver support, and short-term in-home help after a hospital stay.
records.description_es: Ayuda a personas mayores con comidas, viajes gratis, consejería sobre Medicare, apoyo para cuidadores y ayuda en casa por poco tiempo después de salir del hospital.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people age 60 and older and their caregivers.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de 60 años o más y sus cuidadores.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Area Agency on Aging.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la Agencia del Área para Personas Mayores.
records.notes: Toll-free (800) 642-6008. Free rides are for eligible Amarillo residents through Amarillo City Transit. Hours not listed on the page.

records.name: Free Civil Legal Aid
records.description_en: Free lawyers for low-income people with civil problems like evictions, family law, and benefits.
records.description_es: Abogados gratis para personas con pocos ingresos que tienen problemas civiles, como desalojos, asuntos de familia y beneficios.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with low income. People on SNAP, Medicaid, SSI, WIC, or public housing usually qualify. Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident, with some exceptions (such as U visa, T visa, or VAWA cases).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con pocos ingresos. Las personas que reciben SNAP, Medicaid, SSI, WIC o vivienda pública casi siempre califican. Debe ser ciudadano de EE. UU. o residente permanente, con algunas excepciones (como casos de visa U, visa T o VAWA).
records.how_to_apply: Apply online or call the intake line. For landlord-tenant problems call (855) 548-8457.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea o llame a la línea de admisión. Para problemas con el dueño de la vivienda, llame al (855) 548-8457.
records.notes: Serves 114 counties in North and West Texas, with offices in Lubbock and Amarillo (local addresses not listed on the homepage). No criminal or personal injury cases.
